decisions.location: Introduction, section 'Anal organs of Drosophila larvae', p. 150, lines 140-147 (and References, p. 161, lines 664-667)
decisions.reason: Although the abstract and one sentence in the discussion loosely cite Waddington (1953), the Introduction explicitly distinguishes Waddington (1942; 1953; 1956) on non-adaptive wing-venation and bithorax phenotypes from Waddington (1959) ('Canalization of development and genetic assimilation of acquired characters', DOI 10.1038/1831654a0), which reported the 20-generation salt-medium experiment on larval anal organs (AO) that this study directly re-tests.

decisions.location: Introduction, section 'Statement of the problem', p. 151, lines 188-193
decisions.reason: The study collected new experimental data from independent laboratory lines of Drosophila melanogaster reared for approximately 160 generations on three different media to re-test Waddington's (1959) published finding on genetic assimilation of larval anal organ size, making it a replication.
